summary: Aetherion Technologies Inc., a Vancouver-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly Westport Fuel Systems), furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Q3 2026 earnings press release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The release highlights Cespira product revenue growth of 85% year-over-year, HPDI 3.0 production starting Q4 2026 with equipped vehicles expected early 2027, and an equity facility of up to $25 million for financing flexibility. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly results disclosure, not a special situation; watch operational execution and facility usage.
